items.title: Bobby Militello interviewed by Monk Rowe, Buffalo, New York, October 14, 2002
items.q: Jerry Bergonzi is an example of a saxophone player who only plays for the love and the art of what he does.

ctx.x: I’m sure there’s a bunch of cats that have no complaints about anything, the Heath Brothers are busy as hell, and everybody’s working, and Jerry Bergonzi out of Boston is working a lot and flying to Europe all the time and doing things. All right. Not everybody is doing well. Isn’t that the way it’s supposed to be?
Name a business where everybody’s doing well.
